messages:
alex: Quick sync — lane lift plan for this sprint. Kernel GC evict work is progressing, batching window change is in a PR, and KV prefetch shim still needs a clear owner. Who can take KV prefetch rollout?

maya: I can own KV prefetch rollout. Will coordinate infra for the canary and write the runbook.

tim: PR #4923 (batching window) needs one more review before merge. Pinging @laura for perf signoff.

laura: On it. I’ll review tonight and run the perf harness tomorrow morning.

alex: Tim — can you paste the exact command you use for the microbench so I can reproduce locally?

tim: Sure — run this locally:```
./bench/run_hotpath --model=fastpath --iters=1000 --window=64
```

laura: Ran a quick pass — median p95 ~62ms, tail still spikes ~180ms on ~80% shard. Need deeper tail analysis.

sara: Heads up from infra: kernel ABI change merged in infra branch — that blocks our canary until the GPU driver bump lands. @infra-bot any ETA?

infra-bot: infra-bot: Created ticket INF-781 for driver bump. Scheduled bump: Thu 06:00 UTC. Canary window opens after driver is validated.

alex: Ok, adjust milestone: kernel GC evict target -> Thu EOD for canary if driver lands on schedule.

maya: I’ll open the deployment runbook and include rollback steps + metric dashboard. Linking PR/notes shortly.

tim: We should gate the continuous-batching toggle behind a model-size metric (avoid enabling for >2B by default). Can someone add a feature flag? @laura?

laura: Yes — I’ll add a flag in config: `continuous_batching.enabled_for_models_below=2000000000` and default to off for large models. Will add schema docs.

alex: Quick dependency list for rollout: 1) infra driver bump, 2) perf signoff from laura, 3) tim's review & merge, 4) maya runbook + canary. Anything missing?

sara: Data-team evaluation to check token-level regressions is required. I pinged @data-team; might take ~1 day.

alex: If data-team is slow, fallback is a 1% traffic canary to surface regressions quickly before a larger rollout.

maya: Opening runbook thread and linking artifacts: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-prefetch (internal link)

tim: Tracking PRs: #4923 (batching window), #4930 (feature flag), #4931 (runbook). @laura please mark approved when perf is green.

laura: Will mark approved after the morning perf harness run and I'll post results here.

alex: Thanks all — if no major blockers by Thu morning we start a 1% canary. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary plan scheduled: Thu 06:30 UTC -> 1% traffic -> monitor 4h -> auto-escalate if error_rate > 0.5%. Ticket INF-781 linked.

tim: Small ask — anyone have a quick loggrep for KV miss metric to use during canary?

sara: Use `kubectl logs -l app=runtime | grep kv_miss_rate` on canary nodes. Also watch `kv_prefetch_hit_ratio`.

alex: Closing checklist (owners): KV prefetch = maya, batching = tim, perf signoff = laura, infra = sara. I’ll update the sprint board and the milestone card.
